instructions: Sheet for The New World RPG, drawn over the printed character sheet. Click a Current characteristic, a skill Total or a skill name to roll 2d6 + characteristic + rank against a difficulty. Mark skill ranks in the boxes; totals respect the roll limit. Click the die beside a weapon to attack: enter the target's Defence and the card shows hit, margin, hit location and damage (critical on doubles, snake eyes always fails, Fatigue subtracted). Click the die beside a spell to cast it against its difficulty. Wounds, Movement, Defences, Initiative, Luck and armour Values are worked out for you. Spend Luck from the Luck box or the roll card. Weapons, talents and spells on Gear & Magic are lists: use +Add for more rows, which scroll inside each table. The Notes tab holds free notes; Settings has roll visibility, sheet size, Lucky and cap talents.
